title: Global existence of weak solutions to chemotaxis models with porous medium diffusion, linear production, and logistic source on $\mathbb{R}^N$
summary: This paper investigates the global solvability, boundedness, and uniqueness of weak solutions to the chemotaxis system \begin{equation*} \begin{cases} u_t = Δu^m - χ\nabla \cdot (u \nabla v) + u(a - b u), & \text{in } (0,\infty)\times\mathbb{R}^N, \\ τv_t = Δv - λv + μu, & \text{in } (0,\infty)\times\mathbb{R}^N, \end{cases} \end{equation*} where \(m>1\), \(τ\in\{0,1\}\), \(λ,μ,a,b>0\), and \(χ\in\mathbb{R}\).
